class.name: Box3DFixedJoint
class.brief_description: A weld joint: locks two bodies rigidly together, optionally with give.
class.description: Welds the two bodies so they move as one. With both hertz values at 0 the weld is perfectly rigid; raising them turns it into a stiff spring, which is how you build something that flexes or that a breaking test can measure ([method Box3DJoint.get_constraint_force]).

members.member: Damping ratio for [member angular_hertz], non-dimensional. Only meaningful when that is above 0: at 0 hertz the weld is rigid and Box3D never reads this.
Stiffness of the rotational weld, in cycles per second. 0 is perfectly rigid.
Damping ratio for [member linear_hertz], non-dimensional. Only meaningful when that is above 0: at 0 hertz the weld is rigid and Box3D never reads this.
Stiffness of the positional weld, in cycles per second. 0 is perfectly rigid.
